keyword: what time does the masters end today
claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is scheduled to conclude on Sunday, April 12.
TV coverage on CBS for the final round of the 2026 Masters runs from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
The final pairing of Rory McIlroy and Cameron Young tees off at 2:25 p.m. ET.
Streaming for the final round of the 2026 Masters is available on Paramount+ and Masters.com from 12:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET
